name: agc_stream
algorithm: feed-forward AGC: leaky mean-|x| energy estimate (Q23.8), octave-code level detector, log-domain gain loop with attack/release shifts, 8-entry 2^(f/8) mantissa LUT + octave shift, RNE + signed16 saturation
markers: s_tuser(SOF)/s_tlast(EOL) carried to m_tuser/m_tlast; transport delimiters only, no effect on AGC state
gain_code: signed code q4 internal state; applied gain = mant/32768 * 2^sh, mant=round(32768*2^(f/8)) LUT
smoothing: per accepted sample; log mode step=max(1,|d|>>rate); linear mode step=min(|d|,32768>>rate); attack=decrease, release=increase; larger shift = slower
estimator: env += sign*max(1,|ax8-env|>>est); exact convergence, no deadband
clip: RNE(x*mant/2^15) then RNE shift then signed16 saturate; sticky clip_sticky cleared by reset or accepted config
configuration: atomic valid/ready only when pipeline empty; whole-request reject on target>120 or gmin>gmax; cfg_done/cfg_error pulse; cfg_clear zeroes env/gain else retains with bound clamp
reset_defaults: target=100, gmin=-96, gmax=32, attack=3, release=10, est=6, log mode, unmuted, not bypassed
remaining: feed-forward attack overshoot is inherent to the topology
markers are not protocol-validated (stuck/incorrect markers pass through)
